finding.claim: pool.escape()/connection.escape() select backslash escaping when no connection status is available, so on servers with NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES an attacker-influenced value can break out of the string literal (SQL injection).
finding.source: Application value passed to pool.escape() (lib/pool.js:677-678) while no idle pooled connection exists
finding.sink: lib/misc/utils.js:253-277 escapeString, backslash map at utils.js:256-257

trace.note: for...in over Object.keys(#activeConnections) yields indices '0','1'..., indexed into a thread-id-keyed object -> undefined, break
connection.escape binds construction-time this.info; not rebound after redirect (connection.js:2119)

finding.guards_checked: info != null guard (fails open to backslash mode); _searchInfo loop (never finds active connections); connection.escape binding (stale info after redirect); parameterized query path is SAFE (packet-output-stream.js:382-383 uses live info.status)

finding.claim: A server-supplied redirect_url makes the driver open a new connection to an arbitrary host using the original user and password, gated only by permitRedirect, which defaults to true whenever SSL is enabled.
finding.sink: lib/connection.js:2111-2114 new Connection with Object.assign({}, this.opts, redirectOpts)

trace.note: permitRedirect default true when ssl set and rejectUnauthorized !== false
scheme must be mariadb: or mysql:
user/password only overridden if present in URL
original password/user carried into redirected connection
connect and authenticate to attacker-chosen host

finding.guards_checked: permitRedirect gate (default on with TLS); scheme check; same-host skip (2099); TLS verification on new host (rejectUnauthorized default true). Not enforced: host allowlist against operator config; credential stripping on redirect

finding.claim: LOCAL INFILE filename validation is case-insensitive, so a malicious server can make the client read a case-variant of the path the application named.

trace.note: RegExp flag 'i' -> case-insensitive match against client query
parameter branch compares via toLowerCase (also case-insensitive)

finding.guards_checked: permitLocalInfile gate (parser.js:742; capability advertised only when set, client-capabilities.js:34-36) SAFE; metacharacter escaping SAFE; quote-delimited exact match SAFE. Not enforced: case-sensitive filename equality
